svg.aria-label: DataRobot App Framework architecture: component catalog, recipe repository, local development, deploy and DataRobot platform runtime
svg.title: DataRobot App Framework architecture
svg.text: “a DataRobot API token is all you need” — design principle #5
each component is an independently versioned copier template
monorepo, not monolith — every top-level folder owns its dependencies
credentials, tracing and execution environments are wired into every deployment as runtime parameters

g.text: GitHub template for authoring your own
one Pulumi file per applied component
one API token · promote across environments

svg.text: From component catalog to running application — an app is composed from versioned copier templates, then provisioned as code.
